name: Journey to the Crossroads

angles.text: Your journey brings you to the Horde's rugged frontier in Kalimdor, where you are called to prove yourself in its service.

You have arrived in Azeroth from the elemental plane. Mortal conflicts may seem small beside what you have known, but the Horde's dangers are real, and you are urged to prove your mettle in its service.

faq.answer: Thork is a Horde authority stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He oversees the local defense and directs newcomers to help against threats to the settlement and nearby lands.

The Crossroads is a Horde outpost and trading hub where major trails meet in the Barrens. Hostile wildlife, centaur tribes, and quilboar raiders threaten the settlement, so its defenders need help keeping supply lines secure.
The Barrens is a vast, arid savannah in central Kalimdor, southwest of Durotar. It connects Horde territories across the continent.
The traveler has recently arrived in Azeroth from the elemental plane. Conflicts there may seem vast, but dangers to the mortal realm and the Horde are immediate and severe.
faq.q: Why does the quest mention the elemental plane?

faq.answer: You are sent to report to Thork at the Crossroads. There, you can join the Horde's frontline efforts and grow formidable through honorable service.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Journey to the Crossroads?

faq.answer: The Barrens faces continual aggression from native predators, roaming centaur, quilboar warbands, and Alliance encroachment. Its outposts need capable defenders to hold their ground.
faq.q: What dangers do the citizens of the Crossroads face?

sections.body: You have come to Azeroth from the elemental plane. Mortal conflicts may seem small beside what you have known, but the Horde faces dangers of its own. Service on the frontier gives you a chance to grow formidable while aiding the realm.
sections.title: A Call to the Frontier

sections.body: The Barrens lie southwest, and the Crossroads stands among its broad, sun-baked plains. This Horde outpost is a vital junction, though dangers press its defenders from every side. Report to Thork and join the settlement's defense.
sections.title: The Crossroads of Kalimdor

summary: A newly arrived traveler from the elemental plane is sent to the Crossroads in the Barrens. There, Thork calls for aid as the Horde faces the dangers of Kalimdor's frontier.
attribution: In-game quest text: Journey to the Crossroads
